I answered Pree in a thread on their #central-team message. I said I'd noted that Tansley Parcel's signed order form is due 25 August. I also pointed out that by the simulation clock it's 14 October, so 25 August has already passed. I asked whether they meant a different date or a past cycle.

I didn't change anything else. A deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to mention it in the channel.
